title: Buccaneers name captains for the 2026 season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Buccaneers name captains for the 2026 season
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers have selected their team captains for the 2026 season, with six veterans earning the honor through a vote by their teammates. Quarterback Baker Mayfield, tackle Tristan Wirfs, wide receiver Chris Godwin, nose tackle Vita Vea, linebacker Alex Anzalone and safety Antoine Winfield Jr. will wear the captain’s “C” this season.
